### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**5** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `ObjectQL (symbol, 79 pages)`
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **60** of **216** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **156** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **156**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **101** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **20** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 838a802bf36210a52968d9dfb2fa9fe62a29de01` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `3f43b57b50870ffb0ccc6e48bc8c91e17d9e7c4b` — the merge of head `2af3815d9e444653480ccf23f5b29028c57499fc` into base `838a802bf36210a52968d9dfb2fa9fe62a29de01`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 3f43b57b50870ffb0ccc6e48bc8c91e17d9e7c4b && git checkout 3f43b57b50870ffb0ccc6e48bc8c91e17d9e7c4b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 838a802bf36210a52968d9dfb2fa9fe62a29de01 2af3815d9e444653480ccf23f5b29028c57499fc && git checkout -B drift-repro 838a802bf36210a52968d9dfb2fa9fe62a29de01 && git merge --no-ff 2af3815d9e444653480ccf23f5b29028c57499fc

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 838a802bf36210a52968d9dfb2fa9fe62a29de01
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `2af3815d9e444653480ccf23f5b29028c57499fc`
Local-runs: none
Scope: packages/objectql/src/engine.ts, packages/objectql/src/summary-errors.ts, packages/objectql/src/engine-cascade-summary-rollback.test.ts, packages/rest/src/data-delete-cascade-summary-rollback.test.ts, packages/runtime/src/action-delete-cascade-summary-rollback.test.ts + packages/objectql/src/engine-hook-dispatch.ts (inAfterAbortUnit), packages/objectql/src/index.ts, packages/objectql/src/core.ts, packages/types/src/summary-recompute-answer.ts, packages/types/src/driver-fault-redaction.ts, packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts, packages/rest/src/error-response.ts, packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-batch-data.ts, packages/runtime/src/landed-write-answer.ts, packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/objectql-engine.ts, packages/spec/src/contracts/scoped-context.ts, packages/spec/src/api/error-code-ledger.zod.ts

Inputs read: card #29291 body and all five comments (triage 6575733609, claim 6576326086, claim amendment 6577647622, dev reports 6578447879 and 6579552186), PR #29381 body, file list and `git diff origin/main...pr29381`, the check-runs on the head (every non-skipped run `success`: Check Changeset, PR-body guards, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates with all scoped lint legs, TypeScript Type Check with all legs, Build Core, Test Core 1/8 to 8/8, Dogfood Regression Gate, Test UI, Live E2E UI, Flag docs affected). The cited code was read with `git show` on `pr29381` and `origin/main`; nothing was built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

1. `unlandedWriteRefusal` (summary-errors.ts): matches by `code === SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE_CODE`, returns every other value unchanged, builds a plain `Error` with no `code`, sets `cause` to the original refusal and names the stale summaries from `failures[].parentObject.field`. Right: matched by `code` as every reader of the refusal matches it (`isSummaryRecomputeRefusal`, import-runner, seed-loader), and a code-less Error is what the data door's terminal classifies as `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` (types `data-error-classification.ts` line 162).
2. By-id delete, `runByIdDelete`: `cascadeDeleteRelations(...).catch(e => throw cascadeStoppedRefusal(e, object))` before `driver.delete`. Right: the walk deletes dependents through the public `this.delete` (engine.ts line 20064) before the parent's own row, so a dependent's refusal reaching here means the parent row was never removed; converting there covers the atomic plan (the owning `this.transaction` then sees an already code-less error and passes it through), the `'split'` plan and a runtime that cannot roll back. Pinned by tests 1 and 2 of the engine file.
3. Predicate delete arm: the same `.catch` around the one walk rooted at `matchedIds`, before `deleteMany`. Right, same reasoning; pinned by test 3.
4. `ObjectQL.transaction` owned catch: `redactPropagatedDriverFault(rolledBackRefusal(err))` after the rollback. Right: this catch is reached only on the owned path (the joined path returns the callback directly at line 21818, the degrade path at line 21856), so the refusal escaping here always describes a write that was undone. Redaction carries own properties including `cause` and recurses into it (driver-fault-redaction.ts contract, MAX_CAUSE_DEPTH 4), so the operator keeps the original refusal and its failures. Pinned by test 4 and the commit-and-keep control (test 7).
5. `ScopedContext.transaction` owned catch: the twin, same judgment; joined and degrade paths unchanged. Pinned by test 5.
6. Joined transaction, degrade path (no `beginTransaction`), a dependent's own delete, a write outside any unit, `inAfterAbortUnit` (engine-hook-dispatch.ts lines 74 to 85, catches `instanceof SummaryRecomputeError` INSIDE the callback, commits, rethrows): all unchanged, and rightly so — in each the write that raised the refusal stands. Where the parent delete runs inside `inAfterAbortUnit`, the cascade conversion fires first inside the joined unit, the code-less error is not caught by that `instanceof` check, the owning unit rolls back and passes it through: the caller is refused. Right.
7. Atomic batch (`protocol-batch-data.ts` `runAtomicBatch` / `landedDespiteStaleSummary`): the per-row loop catches every row error inside the transaction callback and aborts through an identity-checked `ABORT` sentinel, which `rolledBackRefusal` leaves untouched. No change to the batch envelope. Right.
8. Answering surfaces: REST and MCP data doors (`staleSummaryRefusalOrThrow`), action `ctx.engine` / `ctx.api` and sandbox (`landedWriteAnswer`), flow nodes (`crud-nodes.ts`) all read the engine's answer and are not edited; a stopped cascade or a rolled-back transaction now reaches them as an ordinary error. REST pin: `DELETE` 200 to `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, rows intact. Action pin: `400 success:false` with the engine message, body stopped, rows intact — the 400 is the action door's standing rule for any throw out of a body, not a change in this diff. Right.
9. Public surface: `cascadeStoppedRefusal` and `rolledBackRefusal` are module exports of summary-errors.ts only; `index.ts` re-exports `SummaryRecomputeError`, `SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE_CODE` and the `SummaryRecomputeFailure` type and nothing else from that module; `core.ts` imports nothing from it; package `exports` are `.` and `./core`. Nothing new is published; no new error code, no ledger row. Right. The `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE` ledger row and its meaning ("the triggering records WERE written") are unchanged, and now true everywhere the code is emitted.
10. The accept set narrowed: a delete whose cascade a dependent's refusal stopped, and an owned `transaction()` the refusal rolled back, answered the refusal (read as success by every door) and now answer a refusal that is not it. Correctly declared as a narrowing of `@objectstack/objectql`.

### ② Semver level

Changeset `.changeset/29291-cascade-summary-refusal-rolled-back.md`: `'@objectstack/objectql': patch`, title carries `!`, body carries the `**BREAKING**` banner, `Metadata-protocol: none`, and the ADR-0087 comment `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` with its category closure. Under maintainer ruling A (level follows the metadata protocol alone; clause2-line.mjs header) `none` at `patch` is the right level for an engine-answer narrowing that adds, removes or re-shapes no spec key, declaration or stored shape; `Check Changeset` on the head is `success`, and that is the gate verdict.
Clause-②: no (narrowing) — the PR body names the key on exactly one line-initial line (body line 6) and the changeset on exactly one (line 7); the "Narrowing note" lines on both carriers do not spell the key. The amendment 6577647622 is honoured: round 1's widen-one-narrow-another value is gone from both carriers. Level axis measured. Right.

### ③ Boundary flags

- open_questions (round 1, non-atomic plan A vs B): round 2 records "ruled A by the seat — keep refusing the parent's caller". Answered. The tree matches A: on a runtime that cannot roll back the first dependent stays deleted, the parent and later dependents stay stored, the caller is refused (engine test 2), and the message says dependents written before the stop stay written. B would turn refused deletes into landed ones and is a widening needing its own card, as the dev says.
- Deviation "action door answers 400 not 500": the door's own rule for any throw out of an action body (verified on the pin; no door edit in the diff). Accepted as measured.
- Deviation "dogfood ran on f1eec6fd not the final head" (round 1): superseded — round 2 reports the dogfood rerun on `2af3815d` and the Dogfood Regression Gate check-run on the head is `success`.
- Deviations on the attribution block, no assignee, the AB0 marker rerun, the changeset declaration line rewrite, PR #29283 having merged (main merged at 8fc7f886), the signed trailer, the queued typecheck rerun: housekeeping, none touches the contract.
- out_of_scope finding 1 (an `after*` hook's `ctx.api` write raising the refusal: `inAfterAbortUnit` commits and rethrows, so the outer caller reads `written` as the hook write's result): real in the tree (engine-hook-dispatch.ts line 84 rethrows the hook write's own error object), correctly left out of this PR (both writes landed, the code is true), and it should become its own card — escalated to the seat, not a FAIL.
- out_of_scope finding 2 (the `ScopedContext` begin/commit/rollback trio is caller-driven): correct reading, nothing for the engine to convert there; noted.

### ④ Design judgment

The published spec on `main` declares the refusal's meaning in the `.d.ts` of `SummaryRecomputeError` ("The triggering records WERE written — this signals a stale/incorrect summary, not a failed write") and in `summary-recompute-answer.ts` ("a write that landed"); `IScopedContext.transaction` declares "committed when it returns, rolled back when it throws"; the ledger row and the v16 release note say only that recompute failures surface as `ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`. No spec surface declares that a nested write's refusal is the outer unit's answer, and none promises error identity across `transaction()`. The narrowing therefore takes no declared capability away at any consumer: every consumer's accept set for the refusal (bulk callers reading `written`, doors answering success) is unchanged wherever the declaration is true, and the two units that carried a false "stored" past a rollback now answer what the spec's own words require. This is the spec's refusal made real, done at the producer, not a consumer-side narrowing. The conversion site is right: the walk's `.catch` sits exactly between the dependents' writes and the parent's own `driver.delete`, and the owned-rollback catch is the only place a refusal can leave a unit after being undone.

Attempts to break it, with findings:
- Three-level cascade (grandchild refuses): the child's own `runByIdDelete` converts first, naming the child object; the parent's walk then receives a code-less error and `cascadeStoppedRefusal` passes it through, so the parent's caller reads 'The delete of "child" did not complete'. Status and rows are right (500 at the data door, nothing landed under atomic); only the lead names an inner object, and the action door relays that message to the client. should-fix: re-lead (or chain) the message at each outer walk, or carry the root object on the converted error.
- The REST 500 depends on the message text falling through every heuristic in `classifyDataError` (the double-quote dodge of the `'object'` + "not" unknown-object rule is documented in the code and pinned by the REST test). A refusal that declared `status: 500` would take the structural pass-through arm (which drops prose in the 5xx band anyway) and stop depending on phrasing. should-fix.
- `ObjectQL.transaction` swallows a rollback failure and then still converts to "The transaction rolled back, so nothing written inside it was stored"; when the rollback itself failed that sentence may be false (pre-existing posture that the original error surfaces; `ScopedContext.transaction` does not swallow, so the twin is unaffected). should-fix: hedge the lead or skip the conversion when the rollback threw.
- Owned transaction whose callback catches the refusal and commits: unchanged, refusal stays, no rollback (control test 7) — holds.
- Degrade path of `transaction()` on a driver with no transactions: no catch, refusal passes through, and the write did land — holds.
- Redaction interplay: the converted Error's `cause` is the refusal whose `failures[].error` may carry driver text; `redactPropagatedDriverFault` cuts down the cause chain and preserves own properties, so `cause.code` survives (engine tests assert it) — holds.
- Export leakage: neither helper reaches `index.ts` or `core.ts` — holds.
No must-fix found. Judged on the tree at `2af3815d`, not on the PR body's account.

## 席位核对 · ACCEPT · PR #29381 · 2026-11-02T14:35Z

Head-sha: `2af3815d9e444653480ccf23f5b29028c57499fc`

**维护者速读(席位终稿)**
- **改了什么**:级联删除被某个子记录的汇总重算拒绝(`ERR_SUMMARY_RECOMPUTE`)打断时，或者一个自有事务因这条拒绝回滚时，调用方现在得到一个普通错误，说明「删除没有完成 / 事务已回滚，什么都没存」。原拒绝作为 `cause` 保留。数据接口答 500,动作接口答 400,记录都还在。
- **为什么改**:#29291。这条拒绝的定义是「触发它的记录已经写入」。但以前删除没落地、事务已回滚时它照样冒出来，各个入口都把它当成功(REST `DELETE` 答 200,其实账户还在)。
- **风险与回滚**:中低，是收窄：以前答「成功但汇总过期」的这两类请求，现在被拒绝。真正写入的场景(加入外层事务、无事务驱动、子记录自己的删除)不变。回滚即 revert。
- **先看**:`packages/objectql/src/summary-errors.ts`(两个转换函数),再看 `engine.ts` 里 `runByIdDelete`、按条件删除和 `transaction` 的三处 `.catch`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/engine-cascade-summary-rollback.test.ts`,预期全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无。席位按常设授权落地，合并即关 #29291。
- **席位意见**:可落。本 head 全部 check-run 已完成(37 成功、15 跳过、0 失败),即入队。

### 核对六项
1. **形态**:draft → `main`;标题带 `!`;`Fixes #29291`,与认领 `6576326086` 及其修正 `6577647622` 一致;6 个文件 +618/-8,都在申报面内(objectql 引擎与 summary-errors、三个入口的测试，本卡 changeset)。
2. **前提实测**:契约复审(CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER,收窄面)在本 head 上 PASS,记录 `6579773378`,无必修项。复审确认：转换点正好在子记录写完、父记录 `driver.delete` 之前;回滚的 catch 只在自有路径上;不导出新符号，不加新错误码。
3. **门禁与 dogfood**:dev 在 `2af3815d` 跑全量 dogfood,VERDICT 0(393 个文件 / 3243 条测试);dispatch-gates 63 derived / 63 run / 0 NOT-MEASURED;`pnpm lint`、runtime typecheck 为 0。消融：动作入口的测试在去掉转换后转红(`expected 200 to be 400`),恢复后转绿。`Check Changeset` 在本 head 是绿，级别轴已测。
4. **接受的偏差**:动作入口答 400 而不是 500,这是动作入口对任何抛错的既有规则，本 PR 没改它，按实测钉住，接受。第一轮的 dogfood head 已被本轮重跑取代。
5. **范围外去向**:复审的三条 should-fix 已立 #29421(建议 p3):嵌套级联的消息领头写的是内层对象;500 依赖文字启发式;回滚本身失败时仍说「已回滚」。dev 的范围外发现已立 #29422:`after*` 钩子自己的写入触发拒绝时，外层调用方读到的是钩子的 `written`。开放问题(不能回滚的运行时)由席位裁定 A,实现与之一致。
6. **落地条款**:`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`,PR 正文与 changeset 都有，各只一行;收窄面契约复审与全量 dogfood 已做。semver:`@objectstack/objectql` `patch`,带 BREAKING 说明，ADR-0087 标记 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`。`Metadata-protocol: none`。`check-governed-merges --pr 29381`:NOT governed(入队前复核)。落地授权，维护者原话:「按照 pm-dispatch 规则复核过的都授权」(2026-10-25T11:35Z)。
